status: single revised prospective design; parent preflight must bind producer/verifier before sampling
native_backend: untouched admitted U0 with LLVM 18 O3_O3; emitted Bril lowered with optimize-egglog=false
endpoint: end-to-end generated-program process execution; compilation excluded
order_rule: For zero-based cycle 0..89, use the declared cycle_order record exactly. Within each cycle run workloads in workload_order, then arms in arm_order. Persist raw rows in exactly that order with zero-based workload_position and arm_position. Session 2 reverses every corresponding session-1 arm and workload row.
timer: perf_counter_ns immediately around batch of 32 sequential subprocess.run calls; validate every stdout/exit/timeout, then write artifacts outside measured boundary
estimator: Per session and workload/comparison: cycle log ratio log(numerator elapsed / denominator elapsed); point exp(median cycle logs). No pooled overall number.
uncertainty: 10000 bootstrap replicates, resampling six whole 15-cycle joint blocks with replacement within each session; compute exp(median logs) over the resulting 90 cycles; percentile 95% interval; fixed seed 20261019.
acceptance: Each session/workload must have Encoding/U0 upper95 <0.99, exact output/exit/timeout checks, U0=B1=SeedOnly emitted/native code and Manual=Encoding emitted/native code. Report every control comparison per workload/session; do not pool. Independent session confirmation is required.
partial_failure_policy: Persist each completed raw observation before the next. If any invocation times out, exits nonzero, or returns wrong stdout, persist the failed invocation including stdout/stderr/exit/timeout and all completed observations in a partial-session artifact, then abort without silently dropping or replacing samples.
preflight_bindings_required: all declared binaries/emitted Bril/assembly paths and SHA-256
verifier_required_assertions: exact raw row count and uniqueness
whole-joint-block bootstrap and all declared comparisons
